author: Elecbyte
notes: P4 Test Fighter B placeholder SFF, inherited through the _template clone. Same KFM sprite container. Its new moves reuse existing KFM sprite groups (standing 200/210/230/240, crouch 400/410/430/440, jump 600/610/630/640, special 1000/1100) rather than drawing new art. NOTE: the projectile animation (Action 1005) reuses sprite 1000,4, which is a COMPLETE character figure, so the projectile renders as a flying figure. Test Fighter B is a prototype-only test fighter: this file MUST be replaced with original art before any release, and the projectile hitbox must be redrawn against the new art.
